text:
Maya: Heads up — follow-up on the prefix cohesion refactor. I ran into a tricky eviction+handoff case when prefixes overlap and one tenant pins a long prefix. Need a quick sync on semantics, rollback plan, and canary gating.

Ashwin: I repro'd locally. When prefix A is a superset of B and A gets soft-evicted but B is pinned, our handoff path moves A's lease to node-2 while B stays resident on node-1 — creates a double-ownership window.

Lisa: Can you paste the trace? Is this only with the new lease sequencer or also hits the old path?

Ashwin: Only with the new sequencer. Short trace: 
```
LeaseAcquire(prefix=A, node=1)
EvictSoft(prefix=A)
HandoffRequest(prefix=A, target=node=2)
KVRead(prefix=B) -> cache hit on node=1
HandoffAck(prefix=A) dropped due to race
```
The core is HandoffAck gets dropped during rapid churn and we don't prevent reads on the old owner until handoff completes.

Quentin: Concern: if we change handoff ack semantics (e.g., make it synchronous) that could increase tail latency for pinned prefixes. Also need to preserve behavior for Dedicated customers who expect pin semantics. Can we gate behind a runtime flag?

Zara: Suggest we add guardrails first: metrics `handoff_ack_latency_ms`, `double_ownership_events`, and an internal canary that fails if double_ownership_events > 0.05% over 1h.

Maya: Proposed immediate plan: 
- Revert the aggressive async handoff for superset prefixes to the slow synchronous handoff path while we stabilize (expose as `runtime.toggle.pref_cohesion_v2=false` default).
- Add integration test for overlapping prefix handoffs and a simulator fuzz test.
- Add the metrics Zara suggested and dashboard.
- Canary 10% dev traffic for 24h with `pref_cohesion_v2=true` before broader rollout.
Assignments: Ashwin -> revert PR + tests. Lisa -> canary plan & dashboard. Quentin -> compatibility docs and release note. Zara -> metrics + alerts.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to dev cluster `pref-cohesion-v2-canary` (deployment id d-4392) for 10% traffic.

Ashwin: I'll open the revert + followup PRs today. Found one safe optimization we can keep separate: compacted lease index (no behavior change) — will ship as a standalone patch.

Lisa: For the canary run I'll add a rapid-lease-churn eval: `tools/sim/lease_fuzz.py --overlap 80% --rate 500/s` and an automated checker that fails the canary if we see any double ownership.

Zara: :thumbsup: I'll add dashboards to runtime/handshake and set an alert at 0.05% double_ownership for pg-prod; will also emit a trace sampling flag for affected leases.

Maya: Thanks all. Actionable: hold broad rollout until two 24h canary windows pass. If double_ownership spikes, flip `runtime.toggle.pref_cohesion_v2=false` and cut hotfix. I'll follow up with a short RFC note summarizing the compatibility tradeoffs and the long-term plan to remove the slow path once we have stronger guarantees.
